long_biography.plain_text:
TMK became the defining industrial platform of Dmitry Pumpyansky's career. A metallurgical engineer by training, he held management posts at metals companies before moving to Sinarsky Pipe Works. He moved into TMK as chief executive and later chaired its board, directing the pipe group through consolidation and expansion.

His ownership trajectory was equally decisive. Pumpyansky acquired a minority stake when TMK was assembled, then bought out fellow shareholders Sergei Popov and Andrei Melnichenko in 2006. He also led Sinara Group, whose holdings extended into rail engineering, development and finance. Both TMK and Sinara announced in March 2022 that he had ended his beneficiary and board relationships, leaving his current principal private holdings publicly unclear.
